caseName: Cahn v. Long Island Vietnam Moratorium Committee
caseNameFull: Cahn, District Attorney of Nassau County v. Long Island Vietnam Moratorium Committee
judges: Ante, Rehnquist, Stated, Washington, White, Would

opinions.text:
Affirmed on appeal from C. A. 2d Cir.

Mr. Justice White and Mr. Justice Rehnquist dissent and would reverse judgment for the reasons stated in Mr. Justice Rehnquist’s dissenting opinion in Spence v. Washington, ante, p. 416.
